style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), bright warm light, rich detail, cinematic depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third and the middle fairly simple (text sits there). Ancient Arabia and Yemen, the kingdom of Sheba.

scenes.s1: A small hoopoe bird with its orange crest fanned out, flying over a vast golden desert toward a distant shining city at sunrise.
scenes.s2: A magnificent royal court of an ancient king: hundreds of birds of many kinds perched in neat rows on carved stone arches, ranks of soldiers seen from behind in the distance, one empty perch in the middle, warm light. No king visible.
scenes.s3: A hoopoe bird landing on a carved stone ledge in a grand palace, crest raised, sunlight streaming in, seen up close, expressive like an animated film animal.
scenes.s4: The people of an ancient Yemeni city, ordinary men in robes seen from behind, bowing down toward the rising sun on a hilltop; in the background a huge golden jewelled throne in an open palace hall, empty.
scenes.s5: A breathtaking palace hall with a floor made of clear glass over flowing water and fish, sunlight pouring in, an empty great throne at the far end, peaceful and bright. No people.
